moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio linear-travel, written here): Dot x 0 → 180 px (demo 200 px on a 320 px canvas) in 800 ms, ease none: equal spacing every frame. The 12 even ticks drawn as it passes and the speed graph are guides, not ported. Site: fade in 200 ms before, fade out 250 ms at the end of the 2200 ms loop. Use for spins, drifts, marquees. Params: duration (0.8 s) · x: quãng đi (180 px) · ease (none). For spins, drifts and marquees.
